value.title: Segways and Water Skis
value.synopsis: What do Segways, water balloons and yo-yos have in common? They all pack a pretty powerful punch! In this episode, we’ll discover the science of what happens when centripetal force meets face.

value.title: Episode 2
value.synopsis: Headbanging, dancing ballet and jumping inside a garbage container.

value.title: Kayaks and Dirt Bikes
value.synopsis: The science behind throwing a frisbee, driving a hovercraft, and a hockey stop, showing when momentum meets friction.

value.title: High Lines and Backflips
value.synopsis: Explores horizontal and vertical velocity, moments, and centre of mass. Many people fall spectacularly as the turning effect of a force is explained. Some lessons on using a scooter to grind a rail are offered.

value.title: High Jumps and Shallow Water
value.synopsis: Science explains how people get hurt diving into shallow water, driving a motorcycle while standing and doing a high jump.

value.title: Ice Buckets and Kayaks
value.synopsis: Sliding down a hand rail on a staircase ends on the ground. Ice-bucket challengers take a hit to the head. Tumbling, indoor sky diving and slacklining to test athletic ability leads to face plants and belly flops.

value.title: Breathing Fire and Running on Water
value.synopsis: Tune in for a smashing time, filled with crashing, falling and exploding. Watch drivers spinning into trees and snowmobiles going off course.

value.title: Ski Tricks and Waterside Drives
value.synopsis: Axis of rotation is studied in relation to skiing; riding a motorbike across water relies on the generation of lift; the importance of drag and momentum while surfing is explained.

value.title: Biking Downhill and Balancing on Balls
value.synopsis: Axis of rotation is studied in relation to skiing; riding a motorbike across water relies on the generation of lift; the importance of drag and momentum while surfing is explained.
